title: Two Coins for the Ferryman (Procession Take)
description: THE VELVET HEARSE (imaginary), unreleased street take recorded at the funeral of Silas Vane: the dirge to the cemetery, the press roll that cuts the body loose, the second line home in F7, a solo horn break, the shout, and the F major chord the LP never reaches.

sections.development: the bell tolls each bar; the theme at half speed in F minor; muffled bass drum; Odile and the mourners hum
a press roll swells from nothing; Odile bends a shout up a fifth; the mourners answer
the second line home: the tune in F7 blues, pram tuba, parade snare, cowbell log, call and response; bar 7 slips into Gb7#11
Brother Ezra alone: the riff; then again with the crowd clapping
the riff as the shout chorus over the band, Odile above everyone
the band holds F major; the bell rings for the living
